references.text: Elishama, son of Ammihud, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Ephraim.
Elishama, son of Ammihud, brings his offering as the prince of the children of Ephraim.
The camp of Ephraim breaks camp under its banner, with Elishama as its leader.
Jacob blesses Ephraim and gives him precedence over Manasseh, which explains Ephraim's leading position.
Moses' blessing over Joseph, which includes Ephraim, describes the tribe's strength.
Summary of Ephraim's camp with the total number of men to break camp as the third group.
Elishama is mentioned in the genealogy as a descendant of Ephraim.
